state.title: Off-Peak Charging Electric Vehicle (EV) Rebates
state.sum: Efficiency Maine’s Off-Peak Charging EV Rebates provides rebates to Maine residents, businesses, government entities, and Tribal governments for the purchase of new or used EVs when paired with an eligible off-peak Level 2 charger selected by Efficiency Maine and installed where the vehicle is regularly parked.

state.title: Clean Transportation and Infrastructure Financing
state.sum: Efficiency Maine Trust administers the Maine Clean Energy and Sustainability Accelerator (Accelerator) to finance qualified alternative fuel vehicle (AFV) projects, including the purchase of battery electric vehicles (BEVs), plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEVs), hydrogen, and other zero emission vehicles (ZEVs),...

laws.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charger Policies for Condominiums and Residential Associations
laws.sum: Beginning Jan. 1, 2026, condominium and residential associations may not prohibit or restrict the installation or use of EV chargers in designated parking spaces.
laws.ref: Senate Bill SP457, 2025 and Maine Revised Statutes Title 33, Chapter 10, Section 576-A
